Container.Name: SceneWhisper
Container.Overview: SceneWhisper is a self-hosted video processing suite for local media libraries, including JAV video collections. Scan and manage video folders, queue scene detection and splitting jobs, generate and clean subtitles with Whisper, repair frame pacing, review processing status, and work with scraped/R18 metadata. The Unraid container bundles the React web interface, FastAPI worker, ffmpeg processing, persistent app data, Hugging Face model caching, and optional NVIDIA GPU acceleration.
Container.Requires: NVIDIA GPU users must install the NVIDIA Driver plugin and NVIDIA Container Toolkit support. CPU-only operation can set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to void.

Config.Name: Video Library
Config.Description: Host path containing videos to scan and process.

Config.Name: Hugging Face Cache
Config.Description: Model cache for Whisper and related downloads.

Config.Name: Hugging Face Token
Config.Description: Optional token for private or rate-limited Hugging Face model access.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: Use all NVIDIA GPUs, a specific GPU id, or void for CPU-only mode.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities
Config.Description: NVIDIA runtime capabilities used by AI and ffmpeg workloads.

Config.Name: Hugging Face Transfer
Config.Description: Enable faster Hugging Face model downloads.
